pr_title: Add cinema mod selection shortcut to song select
pr_body:
# Summary

Closes #9221

- Adds the cinema mod selection shortcut to song select <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd>
- A notification similar to what was implemented in #9168 will be displayed if the user attempts to start a beatmap using a ruleset which hasn't an available cinema mod.

## Testing
~~Again no automatic testing as it is quite hard to automate.
However, manual testing shows it works as expected.~~

See `TestScenePlaySongSelect` test scene.
pr_comments:
This addition also exposes the following bug:

1. Manually select the autoplay mod via the mod overlay.
2. Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> to progress into gameplay.
3. Gameplay will start with *both* autoplay and cinema shown in the player loader, which should not be a valid combination in the first place.

I would like to see an automated test case for this.
Also not sure we want this shortcut going forwards. Seems like a *very* rare use case with little benefit.
Well if usage is deemed too rare (compared to the auto shortcut) to be added back as a shortcut, then this can be closed.
Thanks for the implementation, but given that the implementation required to make this work is quite chunky with little benefit, let's hold off on this for the time being.

issue_context.title: Cinema mod shortcut not implemented
issue_context.body: **Describe the feature:** Shortcut is <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd>. Right now it just enables autoplay (because of <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd>) in song select.
comments: Closing for now as it seems that the shortcut is not used a lot as commented in the linked PRs. May come back as a global hotkey (https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/6092#issuecomment-531557940).

review_comments:
Could simplify by doing
```suggestion
            AddAssert("only cinema enabled", () => songSelect.Mods.Value.SingleOrDefault() is ModCinema);
```
Exposition of `ModSelect` shouldn't be necessary - `SelectedMods` is exposed as protected in `OsuTestScene`.

Having a `SelectTypes` method with a `deselect` parameter is quite dubious, especially given that its xmldoc shows the name is misleading. It should at worst be named `deselectOthers`, and at best not exist at all.

Have you looked at enforcing this via specifying `IncompatibleMods`?

Actually the method I came up with doesn't look fine anymore to me for the sole reason that I discovered it was working fine because it made the assumption that `ModAutoplay` and `ModCinema` were inside a MultiMod (that's the case for the 4 default rulesets, tested this by moving the `Autoplay` and `Cinema` mod implementations out of the MultiMod for the osu! ruleset). So i'll probably remove the whole method.

So I may now be more in favour of adding a check inside `trySelectMod` to ensure that the selected auto mod isn't incompatible with the already selected mods (by checking against `IncompatibleMods` property + a `IsSubclassOfCheck` (would love to hear your opinion on this).

I may give this a shot tomorrow but can't say for sure.
